description: Source code for managing Extended Validation (EV) root CA metadata, including functions for adding, removing, and querying EV policy OIDs and associated root CA fingerprints.

classes.name: EVRootCAMetadata
classes.description: Class managing EV root CA metadata, including EV policy OIDs and associated root CA fingerprints.

methods.name: EVRootCAMetadata::IsEVPolicyOID
methods.description: Checks if a given policy OID is recognized as an EV policy.

methods.name: EVRootCAMetadata::HasEVPolicyOID
methods.description: Checks if a specific EV policy OID is associated with a given root CA fingerprint.

methods.name: EVRootCAMetadata::AddEVCA
methods.description: Adds a new EV CA with its associated policy OID.

methods.name: EVRootCAMetadata::RemoveEVCA
methods.description: Removes an EV CA entry based on its fingerprint.
